_version_comment: The file's format. A file without version 2 is from before 1.14: TokenTab renames it to budget.json.old and writes these defaults.
_budgets_comment: Master switch for the budget: the type and limit below. false (the default) checks nothing and keeps the values for when you turn it on (/tokentab:budget, or Enabled under BUDGET on the Settings tab). The pane's headline follows the budget type while it is on.
_unit_comment: Your account decides what a budget counts: percent of the plan's usage windows where Claude Code reports them (Pro, Max, Team), else USD (Enterprise, API keys; priced from prices.json). Only the budget type picked for that unit is checked.
_type_comment: The one budget checked, per unit, so switching accounts keeps each one's pick. usd: today (daily_limit_usd, every session, resets at midnight) or session (session_limit_usd). percent: today (what is left of the week spread over the days left), week or five_hour, each against Anthropic's own 100%, with no limit of its own.
_comment: The USD limits; null disables one. Only the limit of the type in effect is checked.
_hard_stop_comment: USD only: true stops prompts and tool calls at the limit. On Pro, Max and Team Anthropic stops at 100% itself.
_spend_less_comment: Beta. true (the default) also asks Claude to spend less (cheaper actions, shorter replies, and with hard_stop on, to wrap up) at each warning. false only warns you.
_daily_comment: Percent budget type today. carry_over (beta): an even seventh of the week a day, plus what earlier days left unused, minus what they overspent.
_context_comment: Context size of the last call. Every call re-reads it all, so this is what each call costs. Warns once per threshold; resets after a compact.
_cold_comment: Blocks the first prompt after the prompt cache has expired, before anything is sent, when re-writing the context would be expensive. Sending again within confirm_seconds goes ahead. fresh_session_tokens estimates what a new session writes to start: the ~45k baseline plus ~30k re-read.
_handoff_comment: Shortly before a large context's prompt cache expires (write_at_minutes_1h / _5m after the last call, while the session sits idle and open), asks Claude once for a handoff note and saves it as handoff/<session>.md in the plugin's data folder. That one request reads the cache at the cheap rate. When you come back to a cold cache, the question above the prompt box offers to continue in a new chat from the note. Needs the session open and the computer awake.
_new_session_comment: Sends Claude the context size, cost per call and break-even for a new session with every prompt, so it can suggest one when the new prompt does not need this conversation.
_helpers_comment: Helper (subagent) tool calls get hard stops but not warnings and cannot start other agents unless helpers_may_delegate.
